TASK_GAP 2
Requirement: Per the changelog convention, one fragment per PR; the unique path is the load-bearing signal so that two concurrent PRs cannot collide on `CHANGELOG.md`. Two fragments describing the same code change from one PR dilute that signal and re-introduce the per-PR edit contention the rule was written to remove.
Expected change site: A single fragment in `changelog.d/` describing the merged-PR guard redirect fix (the observable behavior this PR actually ships).
Evidence of absence: `changelog.d/6321-merge-guard-empty-quote-fd.md` (category `fixed`, 6 lines, "The merged-PR guard checks numeric branch refspecs even when prefixed with empty quotes") and `changelog.d/6333-quoted-numeric-refspec-fd-guard.md` (category `security`, 2 lines, "Quoted numeric push refspecs now receive the merged-PR guard check") both describe the same hook parser change in `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-295` and its template twin from different angles. The 6133 fragment already on the workspace manifest (`changelog.d/6133-pr-merge-guard-live-copy-sync.md`) further compounds the per-PR split.
